title: CISA #StopRansomware Operational Response Checklist Playbook
scope: CISA #StopRansomware Guide Part 2 incident response checklist for detection, containment, eradication, and recovery.

steps.activity: Determine impacted systems and identify ransomware variant indicators
steps.description: Verify encrypted file extensions, ransom note, and shadow copy deletion.

source_anchor.quote_or_summary: Verify encrypted file extensions, ransom note, and shadow copy deletion.

steps.activity: Isolate infected hosts immediately and sever shared network/AD paths
steps.description: Disconnect compromised systems from network while preserving volatile memory if feasible.

source_anchor.quote_or_summary: Disconnect compromised systems from network while preserving volatile memory if feasible.

steps.activity: Triage initial access vector, persistence, and data exfiltration scope
steps.description: Audit VPN/RDP logs, privileged accounts, and outbound transfers for double extortion.

source_anchor.quote_or_summary: Audit VPN/RDP logs, privileged accounts, and outbound transfers for double extortion.

steps.activity: Engage CISA/Law Enforcement and validate immutable offline backups
steps.description: Notify CISA/FBI and verify clean golden images and uncorrupted backups before restore.
steps.condition: Triggered when investigation confirms active compromise or operational impact.

source_anchor.quote_or_summary: Notify CISA/FBI and verify clean golden images and uncorrupted backups before restore.

steps.activity: Rebuild clean systems, rotate domain credentials, and close incident
steps.description: Restore from verified backups, reset krbtgt/privileged accounts, and complete lessons learned.

source_anchor.quote_or_summary: Restore from verified backups, reset krbtgt/privileged accounts, and complete lessons learned.
